1479-2841-6156-8293.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

539-3821-4679-6798-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4679-6798-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 2.

4279-4976-7452--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4976-7452--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

765-1432-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
765-1432-2645-3430.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

277-1308-2557-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-1308-2557-4094-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

3812-6287-7704.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness and has power 6 or greater.
Simic Ragworm and Doc Samson are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
3812-6287-7704.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Doc Samson.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Simic Ragworm.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3368-5148.notablePrerequisites: Basic lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}{R}.
3368-5148.description:
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate all basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{R}.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, copying Early Harvest and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Early Harvest, untapping all basic lands you control.
Repeat from step 2.

630-4657-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three in any combination of Mountains, Forests and/or Plains.
630-4657-5295-6871.description:
Activate three in any combination of Mountains, Forests and/or Plains by tapping them, adding {3}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers three times, adding {3}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
630-4657-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

206-252-4871.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
206-252-4871.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

891-2843-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

628-4659-7219.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Ironworks ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2829-6972-7160.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1183-4853-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Sol Ring.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

4772-6568-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
4772-6568-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doubling Season.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

671-2173-5073-5220.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Tinder Wall enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2178-5969-5970-6798.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Marina.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
2178-5969-5970-6798.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocked Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a Devil.
When the Devil dies, it and Marina trigger.
Resolve the Devil's trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

527-1323-4687.easyPrerequisites: Rydia does not have summoning sickness.
527-1323-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

222-527-2921-3480.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2921-3480.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

101-372-695.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-695.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1778-5147-5220-5683.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Memnite from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Memnite and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1636-3143-5528.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature token that has base power or toughness that is greater than Sharp-Eyed Rookie's power or toughness.
You control a permanent that has a counter on it.
1636-3143-5528.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of another creature token with base power or toughness that is greater than Sharp-Eyed Rookie's power or toughness.
When the Wolf token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Sharp-Eyed Rookie trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Sharp-Eyed Rookie trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.

81-3076-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 3 or greater and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.

Sleep-Cursed Faerie exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.

Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by paying {1}{U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

Draw a card.

When the Tentacle enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1475-2816-5256.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Umbral Mantle attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
1475-2816-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with Umbral Mantle attached.
When the creature dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

Activate Moritte by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.

Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter token with changeling.
Ayula and Bishop of Wings trigger.
Resolve Ayula's trigger, causing the Shapeshifter to fight any creature you don't control with power 2 or greater.
The Shapeshifter dies, triggering Bishop of Wings, creating a 1/1 Spirit token with all creature types.
Ayula and Bishop of Wings trigger.
Resolve Ayula's trigger, causing the Spirit to fight any creature you don't control with power 1 or greater.
The Shapeshifter dies, triggering Bishop of Wings, creating a 1/1 Spirit token with all creature types.
Repeat from step 5 until all creatures opponents control with 1 or more power have died.
Resolve all Bishop of Wings triggers, gaining 4 life for each creature that entered the battlefield during this combo.

539-1207-1909.notablePrerequisites: Ashaya does not have summoning sickness.
539-1207-1909.description:
Activate Ashaya by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Ashaya.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.

2532-4050-4404.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-4050-4404.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor with haste.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Corridor Monitor token, adding {R}.
The Corridor Monitor token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

678-3693.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
